people.imagined: Afternoon in the assay room. He has just been handed a cup of tea and holds it a long moment under his nose, weighing it as he weighs everything, the tips of his fingers silver with old burns. He wonders whether he will be thought honest when dead.
people.subject: The moment: in the late afternoon of the assay room he holds a small cup of tea in both hands at chest height and studies it with a weighing, sidelong look, in no hurry to drink. Face: a lean, long, grey old face, deeply lined, the skin dry and pale; narrow dark eyes under heavy lids, shrewd; thin grey brows; a long, thin, slightly hooked nose; a thin, tight mouth with a faint dry curl; a thin white goatee. Hair: silver-grey, thin, drawn back into a small tight knot under a gold crown shaped like a balance beam, with a plain silver pin. Body: lean, spare, a little stooped, narrow shoulders. Clothing: as head of the house, the richest of the sheet: layered robes of gold-threaded brocade in dove-grey and mustard, three crossed collars embroidered with golden scales and balances, over it a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk whose hem is scorched and mended in silver thread; a sash hung with tiny gold weights and a small brass balance. Power: a pale silver-gold aura of metal qi, with fine silver motes drifting round his hands. Hands and objects: both hands wrap a small white porcelain tea cup; the fingertips of both hands are marked with small, shiny, silver-white burn scars, plainly visible against the white cup. Background: a pale room dissolving into mist, shelves of small weights and brass scales, a small clay crucible on a stand glowing red behind. Light: soft warm moonlike light from the upper left, a dull orange glow from the crucible, a silver rim light. Expression: dry, weighing, courteous, guarded.

people.imagined: Bright morning at the open square. She stands at her side of the scale with a set of brass weights clicking in her palm, watching the miners' line grow longer than the Pivot's. She smiles very slightly. She has plans for the whole square.
people.subject: The moment: in bright morning at the open square she stands at her side of the scale, rolling a small set of brass weights in her palm, and gives a small, pleased, sidelong smile at the line of customers beyond the frame. Face: a small, quick, sharp-featured woman's face; warm tan skin; bright dark eyes, shrewd and amused; neatly arched thin brows; a small straight nose; full lips set in a pleased curl; a tiny mole at the corner of the mouth. Hair: glossy black, in a high neat knot pinned with a gold hairpin and a small gold balance-beam ornament; one polished curl at each ear. Body: small, quick and compact, straight-backed. Clothing: an elder's rich dress: a robe of deep wine-red silk woven with a fine pattern of small gold coins, two or three crossed collars embroidered with golden scales and balances, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk with rolled wide sleeves, gold-threaded brocade at the cuffs; a sash hung with tiny gold weights and a small brass balance. Power: a soft golden-green glow of wood qi about her hands and a few drifting leaf-bright motes. Hands and objects: in the right palm five little cylindrical brass weights with a bright shine; the left hand rests on the edge of a brass balance with two shallow pans, partly in shot. Background: a sunlit square in drifting mist, bridge rails, a line of miners with baskets. Light: strong bright morning light from the upper left, a glint on the brass and a soft rim light. Expression: bright, shrewd, mildly pleased, avid beneath.

people.imagined: Night at the three furnaces. He stands in the red glow, the grey colour of his skin showing silver in the firelight, his eyes red-rimmed. He holds a bit of dark iron and wonders silently whether it is star iron.
people.subject: The moment: at night he stands before an open furnace mouth, holding a small dark lump of iron in long tongs and examining it with red, narrowed eyes, silently wondering whether it is star iron. Face (most important): his skin is a dull silver-grey, like old pewter, all over face and neck, and the whites of his eyes are rimmed raw red. A stooped old man's long, hollow face, the cheeks fallen in and cut with deep lines, the heavy brows singed pale, the nose long, the mouth thin and colourless. Hair: sparse, short, iron-grey, cut close to the skull. Body: stooped and narrow-shouldered, with long arms that hang forward as if still reaching for the fire. Clothing: layered dark-mustard silk robes with two crossed collars embroidered with golden scales, a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk, one cuff burnt through and mended neatly in the same blue thread, a dark silk smith's apron tied over the front, a thick glove on the left hand, a sash hung with tiny gold weights. Power: a silver-grey haze of metal qi coils off his skin, with sparks and silver motes rising from the furnace. Hands and objects: both hands hold the iron tongs, gripping a small lump of dark grey metal with a faint glow in it. Background: the white-orange mouth of the furnace glowing, a few drifting sparks, dark roof timbers lost in mist above. Light: intense orange-red firelight from the front and right, so the cool pewter grey of his skin shows through the glow, with a thin silver rim light. Expression: weary and intent, the brow drawn down, the mouth slack with patient, quiet doubt.

people.imagined: Midday on the north bridge. She leans easily on the rail, a jade bracelet on each wrist, a thick book of tolls under one arm, handsome and unhurried. She carries her grandfather's terms in her pocket and is in no hurry to deliver them.
people.subject: The moment: at midday on a stone bridge she leans one elbow on the rail and looks at the viewer with a relaxed, handsome smile, a thick book tucked under the other arm. Face: a handsome, easy face, oval, pale brown, with high cheekbones; large warm dark eyes, lightly amused and a little too knowing; arched brows; a straight fine nose; a wide mouth with a slight, easy smile; a beauty mark at the left temple. Hair: black, long, half bound up at the crown by two jade combs, the rest falling over one shoulder in a glossy sheet. Body: tall, easy, long-limbed, relaxed lean. Clothing: a flowing robe of dove-blue silk with a wide soft collar and two more crossed collars embroidered with golden scales and balances, wide sleeves falling to the wrist, under a short blue over-robe worn open and loose, its borders brocaded with gold; a sash hung with tiny gold weights. Power: a gentle blue-green glow of water qi with floating droplets of light about her sleeves. Hands and objects: on each wrist a wide pale-green jade bracelet, clear and bright, one on the visible left, one on the right; a thick bound book with a plain cloth cover under the left arm. Background: a stone bridge with twin arches, a bright river, mist and sun glitter on the water. Light: bright midday light from the upper left, a glow of jade at the wrist and a soft rim light. Expression: easy, charming, calculating.

people.imagined: Noon on the square, voice gone. He has shouted across at the Pivot's assayer since dawn and is hoarse, with a smear of ore dust across the cheek. He bangs a sample of ore down on the table and glares. He would be horrified to know about the weight he works beside.
people.subject: The moment: at the weighing table at noon, he slams a lump of grey ore down with a bang and glares across the square, mouth wide open in a hoarse shout. Face (most important): a long smear of grey-black ore dust runs across his left cheek like a signature, plainly visible. A broad, heavy, florid face with deep red cheeks and short grey stubble; the dark eyes furious beneath thick bristling brows, the nose big and blunt, the neck cords standing out as the voice cracks. Hair: thick grey-brown, cropped short and bristling like a brush. Body: broad and barrel-chested, with big hands, leaning hard forward over the table. Clothing: a robe of dark green silk with two crossed collars embroidered with golden scales and balances, the collar slightly crushed by shouting and shoving, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk dusted with ore, the wide sleeves rolled to the elbow; a sash hung with tiny gold weights. Power: a ruddy ochre glow of earth qi about his fist and a few motes of ore-dust light. Hands and objects: the right hand presses a fist-sized lump of dull grey ore onto the wooden table; the left hand points straight across the square, finger out; a small set of brass weights and a pair of tongs lie on the table. Background: a sunlit square in drifting mist, the rival weighing table far across it, miners with baskets drifting between. Light: harsh bright noon light from the upper left, hard on his flushed skin, with a pale rim light. Expression: a red-faced, hoarse fury, honest and unhidden, the glare of a man sure he is being cheated.

people.imagined: Evening at a table in the new counter at the silver mine. He has set a small brass spirit-level on the table and watches the bubble settle. His left foot, dragging from the dropped ingot, is stretched out under the table.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table in the evening, he has set a small brass spirit-level on the tabletop and bends his head to watch the bubble settle, one hand steadying it. Face: a plain, honest, square face, tanned; a long, steady gaze of dark brown eyes, level; straight brows with a faint furrow between them, as if he is always checking something level in his mind; a short straight nose; a firm mouth, slightly downturned; a clean-shaven chin with a faint shadow. Hair: black, short and tidy, parted at the side, held by a small silver clasp. Body: sturdy, broad, seated square, his left foot stretched out a little crookedly beneath the table. Clothing: a robe of fine mustard silk with two crossed collars embroidered with golden scales and balances and clean white cuffs, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk, well kept; a sash hung with tiny gold weights and a small brass balance. Power: a faint silver glow of metal qi along his fingertips, with a few still motes of light. Hands and objects: a small polished brass spirit-level the length of a hand with a glass vial in the middle, his thumb on one end; on the table a flat steel straight-edge and a small plumb weight on a thread, set neatly parallel to the level. Background: a plain counter room fading into mist, a window with evening light, scales on a shelf. Light: warm evening light from the upper left, a bright gleam on the brass and a soft silvery rim light. Expression: steady, patient and exact.

people.imagined: Midday in the weighing room. She does not blink. Nine silvers lie in a row before her and she looks at them with her wide, dark, unblinking eyes. She decides a grade by her mood.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table at midday in the weighing room, she stares fixedly at a row of nine small silver bars with wide, unblinking dark eyes, about to give her verdict. Face (most important): her eyes are very wide and perfectly still, dark and glossy, with no blink, fixed on one point. A pale, delicate, serious oval face with faintly flushed cheekbones, thin high brows, a small straight nose and a small tight closed mouth; the chin lifts slightly, as if in judgement. Hair: black, gathered in two high buns tied with plain blue silk ribbons, not a strand loose. Body: small, upright and neat, with narrow shoulders held very square. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a young disciple: a crisp robe of dark green silk with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk, the wide sleeves turned back twice at the wrist; a slim sash with a few tiny gold weights. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi gathers in the air above her hands. Hands and objects: both hands rest on either side of a black cloth, on which nine small silver bars lie in a straight row, each a slightly different shade; a pair of fine brass tongs in the right hand. Background: a pale room dissolving into mist, a shelf of weights, the faint white of a steaming bath-house door. Light: clear, cool moonlike light from the upper left, bright on the silver. Expression: severe and unblinking, absolute in its certainty, with a faint arrogance in the lifted chin.

people.imagined: Dawn at the scale. She has just let out the morning shout across the square, her voice cracking on the last word, delighted with herself. A front tooth is coming in crooked. She is proud to be louder than the other side.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she stands on a box with both hands cupped at her mouth, shouting across the square, mouth wide open, voice cracking. Face (most important): a front tooth coming in crooked and sticking out slightly over the lower lip, visible in the wide-open mouth. A round, pink-cheeked, bright face; big dark eyes squeezed half closed with the effort; thick short brows; a button nose; flushed with pride; a few freckles. Hair: black, in two thick short braids sticking out sideways, tied with tiny gold-thread ties. Body: small, sturdy, tiptoe on the box. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a junior disciple: a robe of rose-coloured silk with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales, under a deep blue silk over-robe a little too big, the sleeves rolled twice; the sleeve cuffs are stitched with tiny yellow thread chicks and one is coming loose, hanging at her wrist. Hands and objects: both hands cupped around her mouth; behind her on a wooden stand a brass balance with two pans. Background: a pale dawn square, bridge rails in mist, tiny early figures; far across the square a small blue-robed figure with a rival's scale stands against the mist, and pigeons wheel above the bridge. Light: cool pink dawn light from the upper left, a gentle glow and a soft rim light on her braids. Expression: loud, proud and delighted.

people.imagined: The furnace room. She has just pressed her brother's hand toward the crucible rim to teach him smoke and laughs at the blisters. One eyebrow was singed off long ago and never grew back. Her forearms are corded like rope.
people.subject: The moment: at a furnace she gives a cold, amused smile at someone out of frame, her arm braced on the bellows rail, enjoying a cruel joke. Face (most important): her left eyebrow is entirely missing, only smooth skin above the eye, which gives the face an uneven, odd look; the other brow is thick and dark. A lean, sharp, narrow, tanned face with bright dark mocking eyes, a thin nose, and thin lips curved in a slight sneer. Hair: black, tied in a tight, high ponytail with a strip of dark silk, pulled so hard it lifts the corners of her eyes. Body: small and wiry, the forearms corded like rope with a vein standing on each. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a young disciple: a plain russet silk robe with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales, under a short deep blue silk over-robe with the sleeves cut off at the elbow so the arms are free, a dark silk apron tied at the chest. Power: a faint red-gold haze of furnace heat and ember motes curls about her bare forearms. Hands and objects: the right arm rests on the wooden bellows handle, forearm bare and corded; the left hand holds a pair of tongs with a bit of grey metal that smokes. Background: the orange mouth of a furnace, soot on the wall, roof beams, lost in drifting smoke and mist. Light: orange firelight from the right and below, colder moonlike light from the upper left on her sneering face, a thin rim light. Expression: cold and proud, a little cruel, a half-smile of someone thoroughly enjoying herself.

people.imagined: The assay floor, after hours. He sweeps the last of the silver dust into a pan, slides it into a pocket, and looks up with the soft, patient face of a boy who has done nothing. His pockets sag.
people.subject: The moment: on the assay floor after hours, broom in one hand, he slips a pinch of glittering sweepings into a pocket with the other and looks up with an innocent, patient face. Face: a soft, round, mild face with pale cheeks and a faint blush; large, patient, light-brown eyes, blinking; thin pale brows with a trace of fine silver dust sparkling in them; a small, round nose; a small, shy half-smile; a little downy fuzz at the lip; pink at the tips of his ears. Hair: brown, cropped short with a cowlick. Body: stocky, soft, rounded. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a junior disciple: a grey robe with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales, small flecks of silver glittering at the cuffs, under a short deep blue silk over-robe hanging crookedly because both pockets sag with weight, a canvas apron whose pocket bulges square. Power: none, only a few bright motes of dust drifting like tiny stars. Hands and objects: a straw broom in his left hand; his right hand dips into the sagging pocket; a brown paper twist of glittering sweepings sticks out of the pocket edge; a small pan of bright silver dust on the floor by his foot. Background: a plain floor in drifting mist, sunbeams and dust, a smelting stand. Light: dusty golden light from a window at the upper left, the sunbeam lighting the floating motes around him, a soft rim light. Expression: mild, patient, innocent, mildly watchful.

people.imagined: Morning at the writing desk on the square. He copies yesterday's tally, lips moving over every sum, and changes the date. A pen is stuck behind the wrong ear. He cannot hold today's sums in his head and will not say so.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low desk in the morning, he writes with a brush, lips moving silently over each figure. Face (most important): his right thumb is blackened with ink to the knuckle, and a brush is stuck behind the wrong ear, the right one. A soft, fair, round face with a high forehead; heavy-lidded, vague brown eyes fixed on the page, flicking up now and then as if to be sure no one is watching; faint brows; a short nose; lips moving as he counts; a faint ink smudge on his chin. Hair: black, hanging loosely to the collar, held back with a thin silver ribbon. Body: slim, bent forward, narrow shoulders. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a junior disciple: a robe of peach silk with a pale crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales and bright white cuffs, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk, new and stiff. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a thin ink brush over a long pale scroll, the thumb black; a stone ink block and a cup of water on the desk; a jar of brushes stands beside him. Background: the square at dawn in soft mist, the other side's scale glimmering faintly far off beyond the window. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on his hair. Expression: dreamy, careless and bluffing.

people.imagined: A busy mid-morning at the bridge toll gate. She is collecting tolls with a bright smile; the brass toll tokens at her belt jingle at every step. She is much better at this than at the scale.
people.subject: The moment: at a toll gate in mid-morning she holds out an open palm to a passer-by out of frame with a bright, expectant smile, and the brass tokens at her belt jingle. Face: a pretty, round, bright face, rosy and clear, with large sparkling dark eyes, neat arched brows, a small upturned nose, and a wide, charming mouth with dimples; a gold stud in one ear. Hair: black, in a high side tail tied with a brass ring, a string of small brass tokens woven through it. Body: small, plump and quick on her feet, always leaning toward the next customer. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a junior disciple: a robe of leaf-green silk with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden balances, taken in neatly at the waist under a short deep blue silk over-robe; at her belt hangs a thick cluster of round brass toll tokens with square holes, heaped on a cord and clearly visible. Power: a faint blue-green shimmer of water qi, with a few droplet motes, about her wrists. Hands and objects: the right hand, palm up and open, with a few brass tokens lying in it; the left hand holds up a handful of the tokens strung on a cord. Background: a stone bridge, a toll gate with a lowered pole, a short line of travellers, all in soft morning mist. Light: bright morning light from the upper left, glinting on the brass, with a gentle rim light. Expression: bright and friendly, a delighted, slightly greedy smile, the eyes already counting.

people.imagined: Late night at the crucible, just before dawn. His eyes squint at the first light through the door as though he were woken. A small black knife is at his hip, bought at the gate. He has asked three times to fire it and been told no.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the door of a furnace shed at first light, he squints against the grey glow, one hand shading his eyes, a dark knife held loosely in the other. Face (most important): deep charcoal-black creases radiate round both eyes, as though drawn with a burnt stick, and the eyes are screwed up against the light. A lean, long, soot-smudged face with stubbled cheeks, narrow dark eyes, a broad nose and a wide stubborn mouth. Hair: black, matted with soot, tied with a leather thong. Body: tall and lanky, the shoulders stooped. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a working disciple: a robe of rust-coloured silk whose cuffs are black to the elbow, with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales, under a short deep blue silk over-robe soot-grey at the cuffs and front; a leather gauntlet on one hand and a scorched dark apron whose old burn marks form a pattern like stars, practical wear of the trade. Power: a faint red-gold ember glow clings to his sooty fingers, with a few warm motes. Hands and objects: a small matte-black knife with a short blade, its edge dull, held loosely in the right hand; the left hand raised to shade his eyes. Background: a dark furnace shed, a glowing crucible, and through the open door a thin strip of pearl-grey dawn over a heap of charcoal sacks, drifting mist. Light: pale grey dawn light from the right, a dull orange glow from behind, a thin rim light. Expression: tired and stubborn, the squint softened by a flicker of eagerness.

people.imagined: A steamy doorway of the bath-house. She has been laughing so loudly that three walls can hear her. Her hair curled for good by the steam. She has just looked at a coin and found it copper.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy bath-house doorway she tosses her head back in a huge laugh, one hand holding a small coin up between finger and thumb to the light. Face (most important): her black hair is a mass of tight, springy, steam-curled ringlets, springing out round her face. A round, rosy, glowing face with big laughing dark eyes, thin curved brows, a snub nose, a wide mouth open in a big laugh showing white teeth, and a dimple in each cheek. Hair: black and tightly curled, caught up in a cloth at the back, the front a halo of curls beaded with steam. Body: solid and round-shouldered, with a big bosom and a confident, planted stance. Clothing: a robe of soft pink silk damp at the collar, two crossed collars embroidered with golden scales, under a short deep blue silk over-robe worn open, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a cloth over one shoulder; a sash hung with tiny gold weights. Power: a soft green-gold glow of wood qi and warm steam-motes about her. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a single small round coin of dull orange-brown copper between thumb and finger, catching the light; the left hand holds a wooden bucket handle. Background: swirls of white steam, the wooden slats of a door, warm lamplight dissolving into mist. Light: warm, soft, hazy light from the upper left, diffused through steam, with a gentle rim light. Expression: a huge hearty laugh with a hard edge in the eyes, the delight of someone who has just seen that a coin is only copper.

people.imagined: The furnace room at night. She puts her palm out toward the crucible and feels the heat change before any gauge could say it. The crescent burn on her chin shows in the glow. She calls it her second smile.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a furnace she holds one open palm out over the glowing crucible, face turned toward the heat with a slight smile, eyes closed. Face (most important): a pale pink crescent-shaped burn scar on her chin curves like a second smile under her real one, slightly paler pink than the rest of her chin, a half-moon with the curve upward. A strong, square, ruddy face; closed eyes with thick lashes; strong dark brows; a straight nose; a wide mouth in a slight smile; sweat on the temples. Hair: dark brown with a coppery tint in the firelight, tied up in a short tail under a silk cloth, a small wooden pin holding the knot, a damp strand clinging to her forehead. Body: strong, solid, shoulders square. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a young disciple: a robe of dull gold silk with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with golden scales, under a short deep blue silk over-robe singed at the cuffs, a dark apron. Power: a clear crimson-gold aura of fire qi licks round her raised palm, with rising ember motes. Hands and objects: the right palm raised, held out over a glowing crucible, the pink calloused palm lit orange; a pair of long tongs in the left hand. Background: the white-orange glow of a furnace, dark roof beams, sparks, drifting smoke. Light: bright orange firelight from the front and below, deep shadow behind, a thin rim light. Expression: serene, absorbed, a quiet smile.

people.imagined: A lesson he cannot sit through. He has changed seats twice and now twists a jade thumb-ring too big for him round and round. He is asleep on a ledger half the time.
people.subject: The moment: slouched at a bench in a lesson, he twists a large jade thumb-ring round and round on his thumb, looking sideways at the viewer with a restless, bored face. Face: a round, fresh boy's face with sleepy dark eyes and a restless gaze; thin arched brows; a short nose; a sulky, full mouth with a half yawn; a faint downy moustache; a faint trace of last night's ink stain on his cheek where his head lay on a ledger. Hair: black, glossy, a lock across the forehead tied with a pale-green silk cord. Body: slight, slouching, one leg tucked under him. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a junior disciple: a robe of sky-blue silk with the crossed collar open and lightly embroidered with golden balances, the sleeves too long and rolled, under a short deep blue silk over-robe unbuttoned and loose. Power: a few faint blue droplet motes drift about the ring. Hands and objects: on his right thumb a pale green jade ring far too wide, a size too big, slipping; he twists it with the other hand; his head is propped on his other fist. Background: a classroom bench, a window, a long scroll, a neat row of shelves behind him holding weights of graded size, and a second boy at the end of the bench sitting perfectly straight, out of focus, all in soft mist. Light: soft moonlike light from the upper left and a green glow from the jade. Expression: bored, restless, sleepy.

people.imagined: The oldest outer disciple, bent over, in an afternoon doorway. One eyelid droops. When anyone comes near he pats the bulge in his left sleeve. He keeps the true weight there and has kept it for thirty years.
people.subject: The moment: bent with age in a sunny doorway, he pats a hard round bulge in his left sleeve with his right hand, one eyelid drooping, and gives a mild nod. Face (most important): his left eyelid droops half closed over the eye, a heavy fold of skin, while the right eye is open and bright. A deeply wrinkled, round, brown face like an old walnut; white whiskers, patchy and soft like cotton; a flat nose with a small dewdrop at its end; a toothless, kindly mouth in a small smile; large ears. Hair: sparse white wisps on a speckled scalp, a faded blue silk cloth tied over the top. Body: bent, small, shrunken, shoulders hunched. Clothing: an old man's plain but clean robe of old mustard silk, a crossed collar faintly embroidered with golden scales, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk faded almost to grey and well mended; the left sleeve held heavy, a round heavy bulge showing at the cuff. Power: none; only a faint silver gleam of metal qi at the bulge. Hands and objects: his right hand patting the bulge of the left sleeve, a rounded weight shape; a gnarled wooden stick in the other. Background: a sunlit doorway in soft mist, a square beyond, a bright scale; a young assayer blurred behind him lifting a basket, a tile floor leading out to the bridge. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left; a strip of sun lights the bald top of his head and one side of his face, leaving the drooping eyelid in shadow, with a faint rim light. Expression: mild, wily, patient and kindly.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the moment of the great weight, 980: standing beside the newly cast bronze standard weight, his hand upon it, swearing that the house would never weigh for itself. He is calm. The fumes will take him five years early.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a man standing with his hand flat on a heavy bronze weight, as if swearing on it. Face: an honest, calm, square face, pale brown, with a high forehead; steady level dark eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; a short neat black beard with a few grey hairs; a faint furnace-fume pallor in pale blotches on the cheeks and a slight greyness at the lips hinting at what will take him. Hair: black, tied in a plain topknot with a silver pin. Body: sturdy and upright, plain in his bearing. Clothing: a founder's robes: a robe of dark green silk with two crossed collars embroidered with golden scales and balances, under a short square-shouldered over-robe of deep blue silk, a scorched dark apron tied over it, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a sash hung with tiny gold weights; a gold balance-beam crown set on the topknot. Power: a faint ghostly silver-gold aura of metal qi, soft as breath on old silk. Hands and objects: his right hand rests flat on the top of a large bronze weight shaped like a squat bell with a ring handle, the bronze a dull gold-green; his left hand hangs at his side in a fist. Background: a wash of pale grey and ochre mist, the faint outline of a barred window and the pale shape of a balance beam hanging from the rafter. Light: faint, even and pale, as if moonlight seen through old silk. Expression: calm and stubborn, the quiet gravity of a man who has just sworn an oath and means it.
